provenanceNote: Starting hypotheses written from public provider documentation and community experience — not benchmarked claims. PromptLoop refines these through your feedback, in your browser.

fields.instruction_style: Direct and literal; keep instructions unambiguous
fields.reasoning_trigger: Strong gains from explicit step-by-step on analytical tasks
fields.format_adherence: Follows a concrete example better than an abstract schema
fields.verbosity_bias: Can over-elaborate its reasoning; ask for the answer first, reasoning second
fields.context_placement: Keep prompts compact; trim context that is not needed for the task

house_rules.text: Show one example of the desired output
State the tone explicitly (e.g. 'neutral business English')
Avoid idioms and figures of speech in instructions

failure_modes: Occasional stilted phrasing unless tone is specified
